{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Fine-knit sweater: fitted, slim crew neck, hip length, deep burgundy #6B2D3C, merino wool
Maxi skirt: softly flared A-line, high waist, falls to the ankle, black #1F1F24, matte crepe
Textured jacket: tailored, single-breasted, nipped at the waist, sits at the hip, heather grey #8C8F96, wool tweed
Ankle boots: almond toe, block heel of about 5 cm, black #1C1C1C, smooth leather
Small shoulder bag: structured, compact, with a slim chain strap, black #1C1C1C, leather
Drop earrings: slim, elongated, warm gold #C9A24B, polished metal

Why this outfit works: The long black skirt gives the elegant, flowing line you wanted, and the burgundy knit adds depth and warmth that suit an autumn evening. The tweed jacket brings texture and polish for the theatre, and it keeps you comfortable in the foyer and on the way home. The block-heeled ankle boots give the height you asked for and stay steady through a long evening and the stairs. Gold earrings catch the soft artificial light and finish the look without overdoing it."}
